card.name: Linking words before PML and brain disease terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or partial words such as "of", "Other", "set" and "ute" just before a serious disease term. Typical settings are PML, demyelinating disease, disseminated infection and ARIA in warning sections.

modes.label: "of" before a disease
modes.description: The word "of" after evidence or suggestive, right before a named neurological disease.
modes.example: At the first sign or symptom suggestive<< of>> PML, withhold OCREVUS

modes.label: Inside a descriptive word
modes.description: The middle of a word like opportunistic, onset, acute or symptomatic that describes an infection or condition.
modes.example: PML is an opportun<<istic>> viral infection of the brain caused by the

modes.label: Other/acute in a list
modes.description: A modifier such as Other or acute inside a list of diseases.
modes.example: Herpes Zoster and<< Other>> Serious Opportunistic Infections: Consider
